intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in Gurgaon, in our database opened in {{year}}. This page flags a very high recorded year tuition on the London International College side, which may be a mislabelled total.

London International College vs Starex University for BA compares recorded 2023 placements on both sides, and recorded Starex year totals that are much lower than the flagged London International figure.

sections.heading: London International College vs Starex University for BA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Starex University if you want recorded year total fees of ₹65,000 for B.A. and ₹70,000 for B.A. (Hons) English and Political Science, plus a 2023 row with an average package of ₹3 lakh and a highest package of ₹5 lakh.

Do not pick London International College of Law, Technology and Management on the basis of the recorded tuition of ₹9.23 lakh a year for B.A. (Hons) Fashion and Textiles. That figure is unusually high as an annual tuition and may be a mislabelled programme total or another head. Confirm the official circular before you use it.

sections.heading: Fees: recorded figures and a flagged amount
paragraphs: London International College has a recorded tuition of ₹9.23 lakh a year for B.A. (Hons) Fashion and Textiles. This page does not treat that amount as a confirmed annual fee, and it does not invent a lower substitute.

Starex University has recorded Total Fees of ₹65,000 a year for B.A., and ₹70,000 a year for B.A. (Hons) English and B.A. (Hons) Political Science. Treat these as recorded year fees, and confirm the official circular.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: London International College has a recorded 2023 row, listed against B.A. (Hons) Fashion and Textiles, with an average package of ₹2 lakh and a highest package of ₹4 lakh.
Starex University has a recorded 2023 row, listed against B.A., with an average package of ₹3 lakh and a highest package of ₹5 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. BA admissions may use Class 12 marks or a university process.
The recorded programmes also differ: fashion and textiles on one side, and general or honours arts subjects on the other. Read each official admissions page for the exact course.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: London International College is listed at Sector 44, Gurgaon. Starex University is listed at NH-48, Village Binola, Bhorakalan, Gurgaon.
These are different Gurgaon locations. Visit the teaching campus listed on each official site.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want recorded year totals and a slightly higher 2023 average on this page, Starex University is the side we can quote, at ₹65,000 to ₹70,000 a year and a ₹3 lakh average, after you confirm the official circular.
If you specifically want fashion and textiles at London International College, get the official fee first. Do not use ₹9.23 lakh a year until the official notice confirms what that figure covers.
Do not invent a corrected fee in place of the flagged record.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, London International College or Starex University, for BA?
faqs.answer: Starex University has recorded year totals of ₹65,000 to ₹70,000 and 2023 figures of a ₹3 lakh average and a ₹5 lakh highest package. London International College has a recorded tuition of ₹9.23 lakh a year that this page does not treat as a confirmed annual fee, and 2023 figures of a ₹2 lakh average and a ₹4 lakh highest package.

faqs.question: Is the ₹9.23 lakh figure the annual BA fee at London International College?
faqs.answer: This page does not treat it as a confirmed annual fee. It is unusually high as year tuition for a BA programme and may be mislabelled. Confirm the official circular.

faqs.question: What BA fees are listed for Starex University?
faqs.answer: Our records list Total Fees of ₹65,000 a year for B.A., and ₹70,000 a year for B.A. (Hons) English and Political Science. Confirm the official notice.

faqs.question: How do 2023 placements compare?
faqs.answer: London International College has a recorded average of ₹2 lakh and a highest of ₹4 lakh. Starex University has a recorded average of ₹3 lakh and a highest of ₹5 lakh.

faqs.question: Are the BA specialisations the same?
faqs.answer: No. London International College is listed with B.A. (Hons) Fashion and Textiles. Starex University is listed with B.A. and honours programmes in English and Political Science.
